purpose: Implement and validate QKV-only16-bucket balanced hash; measure speed
hash: greedy descending train-input-frequency, frozen lookup, shared across Q/K/V and layers
frequency_source: 4.194304M existing train gate tokens only; no dev/test/label-only column
optimizer: original MuonAdamW; each expert Q/K/V remains independent2D; original LR/WD rules
backend: DeepGEMM2.2.0 same pinned proven build and BF16 kernels
padding: fixed ceil(N/128)*128 +15*128; zeros; no token dropping; stable compiled shape
persistence: lookup saved in state_dict; optimizer/RNG restore and fixed-gradient update checked
outputs: small local reports and frozen routing table; no credentials, W&B, or checkpoint transfer
